text: Pursuant to section 170(2) of the City of Toronto Act, 2006 (COTA), Ombudsman Toronto has concluded an Enquiry into Winter Respite Services for people experiencing homelessness in the City of Toronto in the 2017-18 winter season. We hereby table the Enquiry Report, dated March 19, 2018, with City Council for its March 2018 session.

City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (March 19, 2018) from the Ombudsman for information. 2. City Council request staff to examine the use and implementation of secure remote sensors that measure temperature and upload data to the City similar to what HeatSeekNYC uses.
